bugs.title: Back-in-stock check ignores allocated units
bugs.description: update_or_create_variant_stocks decides whether a variant is coming back in stock by comparing the stored quantity with zero. Allocated units are ignored, so a stock that is fully allocated (quantity 5, allocated 5) does not count as out of stock, and restocking it never sends BACK_IN_STOCK. The out-of-stock check has the same blind spot.
mechanism_anchors: quantity 5 with 5 allocated is out of stock but the check sees 5
setting 0 first works because then quantity <= 0
the out-of-stock check also ignores allocation
bugs.fix: Compare available stock (quantity minus allocated) with zero in both the back-in-stock and the out-of-stock conditions (upstream PR #11714).
